title: Vindhya Bhavan, IIIT Hyderabad

sources.title: IIIT Hyderabad estate office, Vindhya Bhavan floor plans (Dec 2022)

status.layout: Measured: rectangles fitted to the OpenStreetMap outline and its four courtyards; wing rooms from the campus floor plans
status.names: read: room functions from the plan sheets (RB 3.2), functions only, no personal names
status.origin: OSM outer ring centroid in the city-hyderabad frame; rotation 41.7 degrees
status.cellar: partial under C4 and C5; the NE face is exposed (sloping site) with ventilators
status.shading: Estimated: an RCC chajja over every window band, 750 mm on the SW and NW facades and 600 mm on the NE and SE facades, 150 mm above the window head. The plan sheets show no elevations, so depths follow typical Hyderabad institutional practice (450 to 900 mm). No fins or jaalis are assumed.

unknowns: window sizes and glazing (WWR 14% assumed from tag counts W1, W2, V2)
wall and roof build-ups (RCC frame, masonry infill likely)
chajja depths and continuity (estimated, not drawn; fins and jaalis not assumed)
permit date (built before 2014 TSECBC; edition unknown)
lift and stair cores are modelled as rooms, not cores
